args.command: set -o pipefail; sock=/proc/1256/root/tmp/tmux-0/default; echo SOCKET=$sock; ls -l "$sock"; echo '=== WINDOWS ==='; tmux -S "$sock" list-windows -t zenmon -F '#I:#W active=#{window_active} panes=#{window_panes} layout=#{window_layout}'; echo '=== PANES ==='; tmux -S "$sock" list-panes -t zenmon -a -F '#S:#I.#P active=#{pane_active} cmd=#{pane_current_command} left=#{pane_left} top=#{pane_top} width=#{pane_width} height=#{pane_height} title=#{pane_title}'; echo '=== CLIENTS ==='; tmux -S "$sock" list-clients -F 'tty=#{client_tty} session=#{session_name} w=#{client_width} h=#{client_height}'
